code2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not coords:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    projections = [
        ("row", lambda r, c: r),
        ("col", lambda r, c: c),
        ("diag_down", lambda r, c: c-r),
        ("diag_up", lambda r, c: c+r),
    ]
    name, project = min(projections, key=lambda item: len({item[1](r,c) for r,c,v in coords}))
    offsets = {project(r,c) for r,c,v in coords}
    period = len(offsets)
    pattern = {}
    for r,c,v in coords:
        residue = project(r,c) % period
        if residue in pattern and pattern[residue] != v:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent periodic stripe colors")
        pattern[residue] = v
    if len(pattern) != period:
        raise ValueError("stripe residues do not define full period")
    return [[pattern[project(r,c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
